name: gowez
description: Go-native desktop application runtime — Svelte UI, no Chromium, no OS WebView.

scripts.build:adapter: npm run build -w @gowez/adapter && npm run bundle:cli -w @gowez/adapter
scripts.build:sample: npm run build:adapter && npm run build -w @gowez/example-gowez-dashboard
scripts.report:dashboard: npm run build:adapter && node packages/adapter/dist/cli.cjs report --root examples/dashboard --entry src/App.svelte --global-css src/styles/ui.css
